verdicts.reason: A moves the shoe into a tiny icon crammed into the top-right corner, stacked on top of the LIMITED badge and the CTA, which makes the right side messy. Its body copy is squeezed into three lines of illegibly small text, though the headline does dominate. B keeps the original left-to-right order of shoe, headline, copy and CTA, and its body text is a little larger, but the shoe is shrunk to a thumbnail, the headline breaks awkwardly as 'The Volt / Runner', and the LIMITED pill is as big as 'Enter Now', so the badge competes with the CTA.
